name: Onoros the Siren

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the starter of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has the Mark of Chaos (Slaanesh) (Wrath & Glory, p. 136). The Skills above already include the effects of this Mark.

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and optional actions from Space Marine Implants (Wrath & Glory, p. 75)

abilities.name: Pandemonic Ecstasies
abilities.text: Anyone who can hear a Noise Marine must fail an Awareness (Int) Test or gain Hindered (2) until the Noise Marine is defeated.

abilities.name: Cacaphonies of Pain!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Once per Combat, As a Free Action, Onoros broadcasts a soul shuddering explosion of noise. Agents within 30m of Onoros must pass a DN4 Will Test or gain the Hindered Condition.

determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 7D6 on Onoros
note: Print: 'starter of each' (sic), 'Cacaphonies' (sic). Printed in The Sybarite's Grasp sidebar, p.20.
